newsitem.title: CANADA: TVX Gold suspends Montana mine operations.
newsitem.headline: TVX Gold suspends Montana mine operations.

text.p: TVX Gold Inc said Tuesday it has suspended mining and milling operations at its Mineral Hill mine in Montana.
The decision will mean a US$29 million charge to the company's third quarter earnings, or US$0.18 a share, TVX said in a statement. The amount includes provision for future site reclamation.
The company said it made the decision because the continued losses and capital spending necessary to continue current operations at the mine are not justifiable.
Most of the 138 employees will be laid off.
Production at the mine has decreased because of lower grade ore and a shortfall in mill feed from the main Mineral Hill mine, the company said.
Cash operating costs have risen to US$535 an ounce for 17,200 ounces of gold so far this year.
TVX said it will continue a surface drilling program at Crevice Mountain, next to the Mineral Hill mine, so the company can decide whether mining is justifiable there as well.
Mineral Hill production has also been hurt by delays in the Crevice tunnel drive because of unexpected water inflows, said TVX.
The mine, mill and associated facilites are being put on a care and maintenance basis for now, the company said. --
